annotations.title: HUD Section 232 loans on nursing homes

description: FHA-insured HUD Section 232 loans matched to CMS-certified nursing homes: facility, CCN, HUD project name, program, endorsement date and amount, status, note rate, balance, monthly P&I, maturity and servicer. Filter by state, CCN, name or city, servicer, status, rate range or maturity year; sort by balance, rate, maturity or endorsement.

ccn.description: Six-character CMS certification number (CCN), e.g. "015109". search_nursing_homes returns it.

matures_by.description: Only active loans maturing in or before this year.

max_rate.description: Only loans with a note rate at or below this percent.

min_rate.description: Only loans with a note rate at or above this percent, e.g. 5.

name.description: Part of the facility name, HUD project name or city, e.g. "Civic Center".

servicer.description: Part of the servicer or holder name, e.g. "Berkadia" (active loans).

sort.description: balance (largest first), rate (highest first), maturity (soonest first), endorsed (newest first).

state.description: US state, DC, PR or GU: two-letter code (e.g. TX) or full name (e.g. "Texas"). Omit to search every state.

status.description: Loan status in HUD's insured-mortgage files. Default active.

name: list_hud_232_nursing_home_loans
